dana: Heads-up — Acme Gamma says they were billed twice for Dedicated capacity (Feb 26–28). Invoice INV-2026-1134 shows two identical line items for reserved GPUs, total duplicate $12,400. Can finance review and approve a manual credit? cc @emma for accounting.
mike: Thanks. Can you attach the invoice PDF or link?
billing-bot: Invoice uploaded by @accounting-batch: https://redwood.cloud/invoices/INV-2026-1134 (pdf)
emma: I see two lines: reserved_pool_2026-02 x2. I'll open FIN ticket and check usage. ETA 1h.
dana: opened FIN-7892 with details + attached CSV of usage. Customer says they were on Dedicated single cluster. Looks like provisioning job created duplicate charge.
sara: Assign to me. If it's clearly duplicate we'll issue a full invoice credit. dana, confirm customer wants credit on next bill or immediate refund?
dana: Customer prefers a refund to original payment method. Amount $12,400. If refund takes longer, credit on next invoice is acceptable.
mike: Quick check — GL code? For refunds we use 4001 (billing adjustments) right?
emma: Use GL 4001. Put reason 'duplicate dedicated charge'.
sara: Approve manual refund of $12,400 to payment method on file. Please run billing-cli and mark FIN-7892 resolved. :white_check_mark:
mike: running command now:
```
billing-cli apply-credit --invoice INV-2026-1134 --amount 12400 --type refund --method pm_on_file --gl 4001 --note "duplicate dedicated charge"
```
billing-bot: Credit created: CR-2026-551, status pending (payment processor). Linked to FIN-7892 and INV-2026-1134.
emma: Noted. I'll update accounting and attach proof when processor confirms.
dana: I'll ping customer with CR number and ETA. Thanks all. @sara please confirm once processor clears.
sara: Will do. Good catch. :+1:
